implementation.reason_union_pd_filter_disabled: The teacher candidate pool is model Top20 union/cap25 and does not compare union z-scores to the baseline action score.

smoke.result: 6-model max_z_score union loaded, selected candidates, and passed them into Stage A MC. This is wiring evidence only.

small_local_validation.decision: Non-fired cancellation remains exact and one override fired, but the run is far too small for quality and too slow to scale locally.

gcp_runtime_eval_support.decision: Use Spot VM for the next T1 6-model seat-swap; local runtime is about 29s per T1 decision with mc4/confirm8.

runtime_6model_topk_confirm.next_gate: Run Spot VM seat-swap with the 6-model pool. Start with k25/mc4/confirm8 for fire-rate/latency, then k25/mc8/confirm16 only if fire count and non-fired cancellation remain healthy.

expected: visible_dead_cards and private discard fields are present

observed_smoke.decision: Execution path is valid. This is wiring evidence only; not quality evidence.

observed_speed_smoke.decision: All-action local smoke is valid but too slow for broad local generation.

gcp_pilot100_mc16.purpose: Validate distributed speed, schema, all-action coverage, T2/T3 continuation wiring, and invalid-row rate before broad 1k.

observed_partial.decision: All-action Stage9f P2 MC16 teacher is too slow to broaden directly.

gcp_broad1k_mc16.decision: Do not start broad 1k until pilot100 MC16 passes.

candidate20_top10_mc16.decision: Top10 candidate-subset path is execution-clean and much faster than all-action, but existing all-action coverage audit still has one large miss; do not treat Top10 labels as complete all-action teacher labels yet.

coverage_audit_on_all_action_partial10.decision: Top5 is too narrow. Top10 execution is valid, but this 10-state audit still has one large miss even at Top10/Top15/Top20, so broad candidate-subset training needs either improved candidate coverage or explicit incomplete-label treatment.

coverage_audit_all_action40_mc4.decision: Current T1 candidate model coverage is No-Go for broad candidate-subset teacher generation. Even Top15 misses 7/40 teacher-best actions and can lose 7.06 EV on this MC4 audit.

candidate_model_comparison_on_all_action.decision: The current full2k candidate model is No-Go. Among existing small candidate models, stage1b accept2 gray5 is the best practical speed/coverage candidate on this audit, but it needs a fresh heldout all-action audit before broad generation.

union_top10.implementation: hu_turn1_teacher_pilot and analyze_hu_turn1_candidate_coverage now support multi-model union candidate selection.
union_top10.decision: Union Top10 did not beat stage1b single-model Top15/18 on this audit.

union_top15.decision: Better than current model, but evaluates more actions and still misses 2/40; stage1b Top15/18 remains the simpler next probe.

candidate20_stage1b_top15_mc16.decision: Execution-clean, but ShardSamples=1 produced only first-seat records. Use the balanced rerun for quality/speed judgment.

candidate20_stage1b_top15_mc16_balanced.decision: Stage1b Top15 candidate-subset teacher path is execution-clean and balanced. This is not enough for broad generation; it needs a fresh heldout all-action audit because stage1b was selected after seeing audit40.

fresh_all_action_audit40_mc4.decision: Fresh heldout audit keeps current full2k and stage1b Top15/18 as undercovered. Stage1e Top20 and stage1b+stage1e union Top18 look strongest on this fresh audit, but union Top18 was not equally clean on the earlier audit; use another heldout or incomplete-label training before broad generation.

candidate20_union_stage1b_stage1e_top18_.decision: Union Top18 is execution-clean but slower than stage1b Top15. It is not yet broad-teacher Go because coverage is not robust across both all-action audits.

candidate20_stage1e_top20_mc16.decision: Stage1e Top20 is execution-clean and has the strongest fresh-audit coverage among single models, but it is slower than union Top18 and far slower than stage1b Top15. Do not broaden as complete labels without another heldout or an incomplete-label training design.

rescue_notes: rescue4 supplied the final 8 missing rows with fast-skip state replay and fresh MC futures.
Old rescue_sXXX outputs are excluded because they generated only the first row for each seed and skewed the seat distribution.
candidate100_union_stage1b_stage1e_top20.decision: Pilot100 is schema-clean and usable as candidate-subset teacher data. It is not complete all-action teacher data because every row is truncated to the union candidate set. Training may proceed only with an incomplete-label/candidate-set objective; production/runtime adoption remains No-Go.

hgb_regressor.decision: Best current pilot100 training smoke candidate. Continue only as candidate-set generator; not production.

pairwise_logistic.decision: Do not broaden from pilot100; useful only as a comparison.

listwise_torch.decision: Overfits the 80-sample train split and underperforms on common holdout; do not broaden as-is.

candidate100_commonseed_training_smoke.implementation_fix: Moved pairwise DecisionFunctionAsScoreEstimator into hu_turn3_model so pairwise models trained via python -m are loadable in fresh processes.
candidate100_commonseed_training_smoke.decision: Training smoke is Go for the HGB score-regressor candidate only. Next gate is heldout all-action coverage/regret audit for this model before any broad 1k generation.

stage2_hgb_direct_candidate_audit.decision: Do not use the pilot100 HGB regressor directly as the broad candidate selector. Single-model Top20 misses all-action best with nonzero regret; Top25 is needed to become clean on the checked audits.

coverage_refresh_union_stage1b_stage1e_t.decision: Stage1b+Stage1e union Top20 cap22 is acceptable as a broad candidate-set teacher source because cap22 has zero EV regret on the three checked all-action audits. Use it only for incomplete-label training data; production/runtime remains No-Go.

generation_notes: Initial e2-highcpu-4 Spot run stalled after 59/200 shards with memory pressure symptoms.
Stalled instances were deleted; completed GCS shard outputs were retained.
Rescue used e2-standard-4 Spot VMs and single-shard rescue for the final missing shard.
candidate1000_union_stage1b_stage1e_top2.decision: Broad 1k candidate-set teacher generation is complete and clean for incomplete-label training. It is not all-action teacher evidence and does not justify T1 runtime or production adoption.

candidate1000_hgb_regressor_training.decision: The 1k HGB regressor is a real improvement over Stage1e on candidate-set holdout and is useful as a candidate-set model. It is not yet a T1 runtime policy; next gate is a larger all-action audit and/or T1 candidate-set reranking design.

allaction200_mc4_candidate_coverage.decision: The all-action200 sentinel confirms that k25 inclusion is clean for the active existing 2-model union, while adding the 1k HGB/listwise models with max_z_score ordering materially reduces k10/k20 average regret and k20 tail loss. T1 remains runtime/production No-Go; next work is calibrated candidate ordering plus larger candidate-subset MC32/MC64 relabeling.

union4_maxz_top20cap25_mc32_pilot400_bal.decision: Balanced MC32 pilot is clean and confirms the 4-model max_z Top20/cap25 path is viable for candidate-subset labeling. The new pilot400 models should not replace the existing generator standalone; next step is larger balanced candidate-subset MC32/MC64 relabeling, then retrain with more data.

six_model_union_ordering_allaction200.decision: max_z_score remains the best guardrail mode because it has the lowest k20 average regret and best k20 recall among tested 6-model orderings.

six_model_teacher_path_smoke.decision: 6-model max_z_score Top20/cap25 pool loads and executes cleanly.

k20_miss4_mc64_allaction_relabel.decision: The four external all-action200 MC4 k20 misses are not structural candidate-pool omissions after MC64 relabeling. All four source best actions changed, relabeled score gaps are under 1.0, and the existing 6-model max_z_score Top20 pool covers the relabeled best actions by k5.

six_model_mc64_balanced1k_relabel.decision: MC64 balanced1k is clean and useful diagnostic data, but the new HGB/listwise models do not improve external all-action200 k20 coverage over the existing 6-model max_z_score Top20/cap25 pool. Keep the 6-model pool active; the apparent four external k20 misses were MC4/near-tie artifacts after MC64 all-action relabel.

union4_maxz_top20cap25_mc32_balanced2k.decision: Balanced2k improves the active candidate pool on external all-action200 when adding HGB+listwise. T1 remains runtime/production No-Go; proceed to larger or higher-MC sentinel/relabel using the 6-model pool.
